name: t260041_real_llm_extension
description: T260041 extension of the T260040 real-LLM evaluation set. Labels were written from the two T260040 source documents before any model output was generated for these questions. 'required_facts' must all appear in a correct answer (alternatives separated by '|'); 'evidence' lists exact source fragments, every one of which must be contained in a cited chunk for the citation to be grounded. 'derived' marks answers that require arithmetic over the evidence (a known blind spot of deterministic verification).
